name: Miyama Hachie
source:
Star Sign: Taurus
Emerald of the 'Jewel Five'.
3rd year high school student, fortune-telling course.

A green fortune teller with a sweet and splendid smile.
He has a bright and showy appearance. A high class person with great manners.
He's kind to all women, on his lunch-break he is always surrounded by girls wanting their fortunes told.
An artist with sharp instincts.
Part of the art club.
